local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local CashInConfig = {}

-- Resolve a verified sound id from the GameAssets sound table (Coin, Pop, ...).
-- Falls back to the given id if GameAssets or the entry is missing.
local function normalizeId(value: any): string?
	if type(value) == "number" then
		return "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(math.floor(value))
	elseif type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" then
		return value
	end
	return nil
end

local function resolveSound(name: string, fallback: string): string
	local resolved: string? = nil
	pcall(function()
		local moduleScript = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GameAssets") or ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameAssets", 5)
		if not moduleScript then
			return
		end
		local ga = require(moduleScript)
		if type(ga) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local tbl = ga.Sounds or ga.SOUNDS or ga.sounds or ga.SoundIds or ga.SOUND_IDS or ga.soundIds
		if type(tbl) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local entry = tbl[name]
		if type(entry) == "table" then
			resolved = normalizeId(entry.id or entry.Id or entry.ID or entry.SoundId or entry.soundId or entry[1])
		else
			resolved = normalizeId(entry)
		end
	end)
	return resolved or fallback
end

CashInConfig.RING_TAG = "CashInRing"
CashInConfig.MAX_POPUPS_PER_SECOND = 6

-- Verified ids from the GameAssets sound table (Coin / Pop).
CashInConfig.CASHIN_SOUND_ID = resolveSound("Coin", "rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav")
CashInConfig.POP_SOUND_ID = resolveSound("Pop", "rbxasset://sounds/button.wav")

-- Keep cash-in quiet so rapid cash-ins do not spam.
CashInConfig.CASHIN_VOLUME = 0.4
CashInConfig.POP_VOLUME = 0.5

CashInConfig.BASE_PITCH = 1
CashInConfig.PITCH_PER_TIER = 0.06
CashInConfig.MAX_PITCH = 1.5

CashInConfig.TIER_COLORS = {
	Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 64),  -- tier 1: gold
	Color3.fromRGB(120, 230, 120), -- tier 2: green
	Color3.fromRGB(80, 190, 255),  -- tier 3: blue
	Color3.fromRGB(190, 110, 255), -- tier 4: purple
	Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 190), -- tier 5: pink
	Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 60),  -- tier 6: orange
}

CashInConfig.RING_SPIN_DEG_PER_SEC = 45

CashInConfig.LIGHT_BRIGHTNESS = 2
CashInConfig.LIGHT_RANGE = 14
CashInConfig.LIGHT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90)

CashInConfig.CASHIN_REMOTE = "CashIn"
CashInConfig.PURCHASE_REMOTE = "PurchaseFx"

function CashInConfig.colorForTier(tier: number): Color3
	local colors = CashInConfig.TIER_COLORS
	local idx = 1
	if type(tier) == "number" and tier == tier then
		idx = math.clamp(math.floor(tier), 1, #colors)
	end
	return colors[idx]
end

function CashInConfig.pitchForTier(tier: number): number
	local t = 1
	if type(tier) == "number" and tier == tier then
		t = math.max(1, math.floor(tier))
	end
	local pitch = CashInConfig.BASE_PITCH + CashInConfig.PITCH_PER_TIER * (t - 1)
	return math.min(pitch, CashInConfig.MAX_PITCH)
end

return CashInConfig

-- Play a sound by name. With a parent (a BasePart or Attachment) it is a 3D world sound; without one it
-- plays as a UI sound (client: PlayLocalSound; server: everyone hears it from SoundService).
function GameAssets.play(name: string, parent: Instance?, pitch: number?): Sound?
	local id = GameAssets.Sounds[name]
	if not id or id == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.Name = name
	s.SoundId = id
	s.Volume = VOLUMES[name] or 0.5
	s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch or (PITCHES[name] or 1) * (0.95 + math.random() * 0.1)
	if parent == nil and RunService:IsClient() then
		s.Parent = SoundService
		SoundService:PlayLocalSound(s)
		Debris:AddItem(s, 6)
		return s
	end
	s.Parent = parent or SoundService
	s:Play()
	Debris:AddItem(s, 6)
	return s
end

-- Looping background music at low volume (call once, on the client).
function GameAssets.music(name: string?, volume: number?): Sound?
	local id = GameAssets.Sounds[name or "Music"]
	if not id or id == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.Name, s.SoundId, s.Looped, s.Volume = "Music", id, true, volume or 0.25
	s.Parent = SoundService
	s:Play()
	return s
end

-- Resolve a BasePart / Model / Vector3 into a part that can hold an attachment.
local function resolveHolder(at: any): BasePart?
	if typeof(at) == "Vector3" then
		local holder = Instance.new("Part")
		holder.Name = "FxAnchor"
		holder.Anchored, holder.CanCollide, holder.CanQuery, holder.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
		holder.Transparency, holder.Size, holder.Position = 1, Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), at
		holder.Parent = workspace
		Debris:AddItem(holder, 4)
		return holder
	end
	if typeof(at) == "Instance" then
		if at:IsA("BasePart") then
			return at
		end
		if at:IsA("Model") then
			if at.PrimaryPart then
				return at.PrimaryPart
			end
			local best: BasePart? = nil
			local bestVol = -1
			for _, d in at:GetDescendants() do
				if d:IsA("BasePart") then
					local v = d.Size.X * d.Size.Y * d.Size.Z
					if v > bestVol then
						best, bestVol = d, v
					end
				end
			end
			return best
		end
	end
	return nil
end

	p.Lifetime, p.SpreadAngle = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.0), Vector2.new(180, 180)

	p.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.4), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
	p.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({

		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, 0.2),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	p.Enabled = false
	p.Parent = a
	p:Emit(count or 20)

-- CashInFx (client): cash-in popups, sounds, particles, HUD pulse, purchase confetti, spinning collector rings.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("CashInConfig", 10) :: ModuleScript) :: any

-- Sliding one-second window of popup timestamps
local stamps: { number } = {}
local function allowPopup(): boolean
	local now = os.clock()
	local kept: { number } = {}
	for _, t in stamps do
		if now - t < 1 then
			table.insert(kept, t)
		end
	end
	stamps = kept
	if #stamps >= Config.MAX_POPUPS_PER_SECOND then
		return false
	end
	table.insert(stamps, now)
	return true
end

local function makeAnchor(pos: Vector3, lifetime: number): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "FxAnchor"
	part.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
	part.Parent = workspace
	Debris:AddItem(part, lifetime)
	return part
end

local function playSound(parent: Instance, id: string, speed: number)
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.SoundId = id
	s.Volume = 0.6
	s.PlaybackSpeed = speed
	s.RollOffMaxDistance = 120
	s.Parent = parent
	s:Play()
	Debris:AddItem(s, 3)
end

local function pulseHud()
	local pg = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	if not pg then
		return
	end
	local label = pg:FindFirstChild("CashLabel", true)
	if not label or not label:IsA("TextLabel") then
		return
	end
	local scale = label:FindFirstChild("CashPulse") :: UIScale?
	if not scale then
		scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		scale.Name = "CashPulse"
		scale.Parent = label
	end
	local sc = scale :: UIScale
	sc.Scale = 1
	local up = TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1.2 })
	up.Completed:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
	end)
	up:Play()
end

	e.LightEmission = 1
	e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.9)

local function onCashIn(amount: any, tier: any, pos: any)
	if type(amount) ~= "number" or amount ~= amount or typeof(pos) ~= "Vector3" then
